t: This is St Mary's Cemetery in Wandsworth, which opened in 1860. It was set up by St Mary's Burial Board on part of Wandsworth Common, and you may also see it called Battersea St Mary's Cemetery or Battersea Rise Cemetery. Among those buried here is John Humphery, a Whig politician who died in 1863. The Whigs were one of the two great parliamentary parties of his day, and he sat among them. That's about all the material tells me, so I'll leave it there.
